## Purpose and audience

Security owners and implementers use this template for planned, non-sensitive hardening work and its verification evidence.

## Control objective and threat

Reference the threat-model scenario, protected asset, boundary, and intended measurable outcome. Do not disclose an active vulnerability or secret here; follow `SECURITY.md` privately.

## Requirements

Define deny-by-default behavior, tenant scope, least privilege, audit/log redaction, failure state, tests, dependencies, owner, mandatory reviewer, and acceptance evidence.

## Risk and rollout

Record misuse/abuse cases, residual risk, rollback/recovery, and documentation/ADR updates.
